data.text:
VP CALLS FOR BAN ON DUTERTE MOTORCADES, VEHICLE CARAVANS 

READ: Vice President Sara Duterte urges local government units to permanently ban motorcades and vehicle caravans, citing that such events contribute to rising fuel costs, worsen air pollution, and cause traffic congestion.

"While I fully understand the desire to gather and express anger against the administration or show support for former President Rodrigo Duterte, it is, however, more important to be mindful of how these activities impact others and the environment," said Duterte.

"I encourage exploring alternative ways to come together that are less disruptive and more sustainable, since we have a long way to go in making the world listen to the failures of the government administration in the Philippines," she added.

Duterte also noted the crisis of job losses among returning OFWs from the Middle East, as well as the costs of food and other essential products.

Protesters march and hold signs near the U.S. Embassy in Manila, today, March 3, 2026, during a rally against the U.S.-Israeli strikes on Iran.

📷: Noel Celis/REUTERS https://t.co/86WlAte3ge

🇬🇭 Traffic Advisory: Accra-Madina Stretch and Tetteh Quarshie Interchange Works Underway 

Sections of the Accra to Madina road will be temporarily closed for about four months as part of ongoing expansion works linked to the Tema Motorway project. 

Simultaneously, traffic management plans have been announced for the construction and launching of T-Beams (N4) at Tetteh Quarshie Interchange for Phase 2 of the bridge extension. Motorists are advised to expect diversions and plan alternate routes.

PAHAYAG NI REP. SUNTAY, TINANGGAL SA HOUSE RECORDS

Inaprubahan ng House Committee on Justice ang mosyong tanggalin sa records ang pahayag ni 4th District Quezon City Rep. Bong Suntay tungkol sa aktres na si Anne Curtis.

Sa gitna ito ng deliberasyon ng komite sa impeachment complaints laban kay Vice Pres. Sara Duterte. Tinatalakay noon ang pagsali ng bise sa mga rally at mga pahayag niya tungkol sa pagiging designated survivor.

"Minsan nasa Shangri-La ako, nakita ko si Anne Curtis. Ang ganda-ganda pala niya. You know, may desire sa loob ko na nag-init talaga, at na-imagine ko na lang kung anong pwedeng mangyari pero siyempre hanggang imagination lang 'yun," sabi ng kongresista.

"Hindi naman siguro ako puwedeng kasuhan dahil kung ano ang na-imagine ko," dagdag niya.

📷: House of Representatives

data.text:
REMARKS NI REP. SUNTAY TUNGKOL KAY ANNE CURTIS, INALIS SA HOUSE RECORDS

Inaprubahan ng House Committee on Justice ang mosyonng alisin sa records ang pahayag ni 4th District Quezon City Rep. Bong Suntay kaugnay sa aktres na si Anne Curtis.

Ito ay sa gitna ng pagpapatuloy ng deliberasyon ng komite kaugnay sa impeachment complaints laban kay Vice Pres. Sara Duterte ngayong Martes, March 3. Kabilang sa tinalakay sa pagdinig ang pagdalo ni VP Sara sa mga rally at pahayag ng bise sa pagiging designated survivor.

"Hindi naman siguro ako pwedeng kasuhan dahil kung ano-ano 'yung na-imagine ko," saad ng kongresista.

"There is nothing sexual doon sa sinabi ko, nothing immoral... I said may na-imagine ako. I think that is nothing wrong," dagdag niya.
